notes.title: Arsenal Online is now on Steam!
notes.content:
Arsenal Online is now available on Steam!

Overview
Arsenal Online is a 2D shooter with hundreds of weapons and attachments. Play one of many game modes either solo or co-op with a teammate online. You can also enter the Firing Range to instantly test every single weapon, attachment, skin, and more!

Arsenal Online Account
Using an Arsenal Online account is completely optional but recommended! You can also play Arsenal Online in your browser or on a mobile device alongside Steam. Using an Arsenal Online account allows you to seamlessly switch between these platforms and retain your progress.

Guides
Find game guides and more: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2641740/guides/


Discord
Remember to join the official Discord server! Discuss weapons, strategies, and find a co-op teammate!
